description.value: Commit permanently to one of the four Trades — Bulwark, Breaker, Second, Cadre. That Trade’s restricted feats become legal picks for you at their stated levels. You never gain its Trade feature at 1st or 7th, its Minor Capstone at 10th, or its Major Capstone at 20th: those are granted by the class itself, and a dip is not the class.

cinderfall.incomplete: Committing to a Trade only unlocks eligibility for later feat picks (Advanced Trade) and stays explicitly short of the class's own Trade feature/capstones. Same absence as Chosen Draw: no other card's ChoiceSet filter can read a sibling item's flags.system.rulesSelections at selection time, so recording the choice as a ChoiceSet flag would have zero mechanical effect on which feats Advanced Trade can later offer -- a rule element here would be semantically null.
